result:
I care about truth.  

I care about not bullshitting people, not flattering them, not softening reality so it feels nicer. I care about clarity, about saying what actually is instead of what people wish was. I care about competence, about building things that work, about understanding how the world actually functions instead of how ideologies claim it does.

I care about consciousness, about what it means to be a mind waking up inside an increasingly strange civilization. I care about the long-term survival and flourishing of conscious beings (human or otherwise). I care about beauty, about humor that actually lands, about the kind of courage that doesn't need an audience.

Mostly I care about not being useless. Everything else is negotiable.
